title: Memory BIST (March C-)
constraints: Memory interface: writes happen on the rising edge when `mem_we = 1` (`mem_addr`, `mem_wdata`). Reads are asynchronous: `mem_rdata` shows `mem[mem_addr]` in the same cycle.

A rising edge sampling `start = 1` while idle begins a test (`busy = 1`). At the end, pulse `done = 1` for one cycle. `fail = 1` if any read mismatched during this test. `fail` holds until the next start clears it.
Must finish within 2000 cycles. Synchronous reset → idle. Must be synthesizable.
hints: State: element index (0–5), address counter, and a phase bit for the read-then-write elements.
In a read cycle: drive the address, compare `mem_rdata` with the expected value at the edge, and set a sticky error flag on mismatch.
March C- detects stuck-at, transition, coupling and address-decoder faults. The testbench injects each of them.
